text: What is a WTA 250 tournament? Hong Kong and Memphis events explained?. A WTA 250 is a women's professional tennis event on the WTA Tour, ranked one level below the WTA 1000 and WTA 500 events. Alexandra Eala of the Philippines is playing one now: the Hong Kong Open, where she reached the semifinals.. Alexandra Eala beat Antonia Ruzic in the Hong Kong Open quarterfinal and reached the semifinals, where she plays Maria Sakkari. The result puts her one win from a second final of 2026.. Hong Kong is the current WTA 250 in the news. On Friday night, Eala beat Antonia Ruzic 7-6 (7), 7-5 in 2 hours, 30 minutes in the quarterfinal. The match featured 29 break points and 11 breaks of serve between the two players, with 40 winners for Eala and 33 for Ruzic. A rain delay of just over 20 minutes stopped play midway through the second set. Eala saved a set point in the opening tiebreak, the same kind of close escape she had in the second round against Tereza Valentova, where she had led 5-0 in a second-set tiebreak. Her semifinal opponent is No. 4 seed Maria Sakkari, whom she has never faced before. A win would be her third career final and her second of 2026, and would put her within reach of a debut in the world top 15.
